reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT supplier_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC, supplier_id) AS spend_rank FROM (SELECT p.supplier_id,SUM(l.ordered_qty*l.unit_cost) AS total_spend FROM purchase_orders p JOIN po_lines l ON l.po_id=p.po_id GROUP BY p.supplier_id) q ORDER BY spend_rank,supplier_id
